title: Comparison transports q, evaluation, and double-dual boundary compatibility
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $n\ge1$. Put $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ be a closed immersion between separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-closed-immersion]. Use the ordinary constant-$A$ module derived categories on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Write $C_W=\nu_W^*$ for the derived comparison pullback [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback]. Let $D^b_{ctf}$ mean bounded constructible complexes whose derived tensor with every degree-zero module sheaf has cohomology in one fixed finite interval [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes, def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude].

Put $F_e=Ri_{e,!}$, $G_e=i^\times$ and $F_p=Ri_{p,!}$, $G_p=Ri_p^!$, with the latter adjunction restricted to bounded-below etale-origin inputs [def-amb-etale-compact-support, def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed, def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Suppose $\eta:F_pC_Z\xrightarrow{\sim}C_TF_e$ is the proper compact-support comparison, and $G_pC_T\cong C_ZG_e$ is its adjunction comparison. Since $i$ is proper, use its identity compactification [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification], so that $F_\tau=Ri_{\tau,*}$ for $\tau=e,p$. Let $\pi^\tau_{B,M}:F_\tau B\otimes_A^LM\to F_\tau(B\otimes_A^Li_\tau^*M)$ denote the canonical counit-defined projection transformation of [def-kun-projection-formula-map], formed for $\tau=p$ by the same composite on the pro-etale site. Assume the comparison maps identify the exceptional counits and these projection transformations, under the monoidal comparison and the ordinary pullback comparison $i_p^*C_T\cong C_Zi_e^*$ [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback]. In addition, assume that the two projection transformations used below, $\pi^e_{G_eN,M}$ and $\pi^p_{G_pC_TN,C_TM}$, are isomorphisms, and write $\pi^{-1}$ for their inverses. Define $q^\tau_{M,N}:i_\tau^*M\otimes_A^LG_\tau N\to G_\tau(M\otimes_A^LN)$, for $\tau=e,p$, as the $F_\tau\dashv G_\tau$ transpose of the composite $$t^\tau_{M,N}:F_\tau(i_\tau^*M\otimes_A^LG_\tau N)\xrightarrow{F_\tau(\sigma)}F_\tau(G_\tau N\otimes_A^Li_\tau^*M)\xrightarrow{\pi^{-1}}F_\tau G_\tau N\otimes_A^LM\xrightarrow{\sigma}M\otimes_A^LF_\tau G_\tau N\xrightarrow{1\otimes\mu^\tau_N}M\otimes_A^LN,$$ where $\sigma$ is the signed tensor symmetry and $\mu^\tau$ the exceptional counit. For $M,N\in D^b_{ctf}(T_e,A)$ with $G_eN\in D^b_c(Z_e,A)$, the named comparisons identify
$$q^p_{C_TM,C_TN}=C_Z(q^e_{M,N}).$$
Furthermore suppose $\omega_{W,e},\omega_{W,p}$ are dualizing objects, $w_W:C_W\omega_{W,e}\cong\omega_{W,p}$, and $\chi_{W,H}:C_WR\mathcal Hom_A(H,\omega_{W,e})\cong R\mathcal Hom_A(C_WH,\omega_{W,p})$ is the evaluation-defined internal-Hom comparison on the bounded finite-Tor objects involved [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Then the comparisons identify the tensor-Hom transposes of every pairing formed from $q$, evaluation, tensor symmetry and their composites. In particular the transpose of the pairing
$$G_eD_{T,e}K\otimes_A^Li_e^*K\xrightarrow{\sigma}i_e^*K\otimes_A^LG_eD_{T,e}K\xrightarrow{q^e}G_e(K\otimes_A^LD_{T,e}K)\xrightarrow{G_e(\mathrm{ev}_K\circ\sigma)}\omega_{Z,e}$$
is carried to the transpose of the identical formula on the pro-etale site. Here $D_{W,\tau}=R\mathcal Hom_A(-,\omega_{W,\tau})$. In the last assertion $K,D_{T,e}K,i_e^*K,G_eD_{T,e}K$ and their indicated duals are assumed bounded finite-Tor constructible. The dualizing identifications $G_\tau\omega_{T,\tau}\cong\omega_{Z,\tau}$ are assumed compatible with the adjunction comparisons and $w_T,w_Z$.

source.place: Second proof paragraph: adjointing back through tensor-Hom identifies the evaluation-defined map and its double-dual compatibility; transport of the pairings in returned step 9.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-boundary-q-defining-composite-comparison] with $B=G_eN$, $Y=N$, $B'=G_pC_TN$, $v=\theta_N$, and $a_e=\mu^e_N$, $a_p=\mu^p_{C_TN}$. Its counit square is the assumed exceptional-counit identification, its invertibility assumptions are those of the statement, and its projection square is the assumed projection identification at $(C_ZG_eN,C_TM)$ transported to $B'$ by naturality of $\pi^p$ in its first variable, $\pi^p_{B',C_TM}\circ(F_p(\theta_N)\otimes1)=F_p(\theta_N\otimes1)\circ\pi^p_{C_ZG_eN,C_TM}$. It gives $C_T(t^e)\circ\eta=t^p\circ F_p(1\otimes\theta_N)$ in the canonical tensor/pullback coordinates.

source.place: Comparison paragraph: the exact comparison commutes with pullback and tensor and carries the etale projection transformation to the pro-etale one

proof.text:
For $f:F_eX\to Y$ with transpose $g:X\to G_eY$, write $f=\mu^e_Y\circ F_e(g)$. Naturality of $\eta$ and its mate's counit identity give
$$C_T(f)\circ\eta_X=\mu^p_{C_TY}\circ F_p(\theta_Y\circ C_Z(g)).$$
Thus its pro-etale transpose is $\theta_Y\circ C_Z(g)$. Take $X=i_e^*M\otimes_A^LG_eN$, $Y=M\otimes_A^LN$, $f=t^e$ and $g=q^e$. Step 1 identifies the left side with $t^p\circ F_p(1\otimes\theta_N)$, whose transpose is $q^p\circ(1\otimes\theta_N)$. Injectivity of the adjunction Hom bijection gives $\theta_{M\otimes N}\circ C_Z(q^e)=q^p\circ(1\otimes\theta_N)$, the required q equality.

source.place: Final paragraph: 'adjointing back through tensor–Hom and $i_*\dashv Ri^!$'

proof.text: The evaluation-defined comparison of [lem-weil-finite-duality-site-comparison] identifies evaluation and the double-dual transpose of [lem-weil-duality-pairing]. For any pairing $f:V\otimes H\to\omega$, compose its proposed transported transpose with evaluation: the defining evaluation square for $\chi$ gives $w\circ C(f)$ after the tensor comparison. Uniqueness of tensor-Hom transposes proves the asserted transpose equality. The canonical pullback tensor comparison commutes with signed symmetry [lem-sfb-ringed-derived-monoidal-comparisons]. Together with Step 2 this gives the square for each primitive arrow. For a composite of two arrows, compose their squares and cancel the intervening comparison isomorphism. Induction on the number of arrows proves transport for every finite composite of q, evaluation and symmetry.

source.place: Final paragraph: evaluation and double-dual maps under comparison

proof.text: Take $N=D_{T,e}K$. Apply Step 2 to the q factor of the displayed pairing and Step 3 to its symmetry and evaluation factors. Its final factor $G_e\omega_{T,e}\cong\omega_{Z,e}$ has the assumed compatible dualizing square. Composing these squares and then transposing as in Step 3 gives exactly the displayed pro-etale pairing's transpose. The stated finite-Tor conditions on $K$, its dual, their ordinary and exceptional inverse images, and their indicated duals place every internal Hom in the assumed comparison class; no preservation theorem or ambient pro-etale adjoint is used.

source.place: Final sentence: adjointing back through tensor–Hom and evaluation compatibility
